description:
Rate changes over time

Every change of one bank's rate for one currency between `start` and `end` (UTC days, inclusive; default the last 7 days; at most 31). The first item is the rate that held at `start`. Recorded since 2026-09-29. Use for how one bank's rate for a currency changed over recent days.

GET /v1/bank-fx/history on Bank exchange rates (SBX-BANKFX). Costs 1 credit per call.

bank.description: A bank id from /bank-fx/banks, e.g. isbank.

name: bank-fx_getBankRateHistory
title: Bank exchange rates: Rate changes over time
